marketing_description: The DeWALT MAX XR Series 20 V Cordless High Torque Impact Wrench features a 1/2 in square drive and a brushless motor designed for heavy-duty applications. This model delivers 1200 ft-lb of fastening torque and 1750 ft-lb of breakaway torque, managed by a 4-mode speed control with Precision Wrench control. Measuring an overall length of 8-27/50 in, the black and yellow tool incorporates an ergonomic handle for professional use.
